items.source: Designed to support repository method analysis in the context of Ahead-of-Time (AOT) processing, this class leverages ReturnedType, ResolvableType, and TypeInformation to expose both the declared and actual return types, including handling of wrapper types, projections, and primitive types.
items.translation: 旨在支持在提前编译（AOT）处理上下文中对仓储方法进行分析，该类利用ReturnedType、ResolvableType以及TypeInformation来暴露声明的和实际的返回类型，包括对包装类型、投影和原始类型的处理。

items.source:
Value object that encapsulates introspection of a method's return type, providing convenient access to its
characteristics such as projection, optionality, array status, and actual type information.
items.translation: 封装方法返回类型内省信息的值对象，提供对其特性的便捷访问，包括投影、可选性、数组状态以及实际类型信息。
